Photo 1 shows a TV screen displaying the Xbox dashboard interface with game tiles, including 'Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order' and 'The Elder Scrolls Online'. The console is visible at the bottom of the frame, connected to the TV.

Photo 2 shows a top-down view of the same console and controller. The console has a textured top surface and the Xbox logo on the front right corner. The controller is placed on the left side of the console.
All photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DARASIMI MICHEAL'.
The console appears to be the original Xbox One (‘fat’ model) based on its size, shape, and design features.
